Selected normal and enhanced EP/TP records, including original lastUpload metadata. Revision 039cfbc4732c33573568b28cc6335dd3332a9296.
PvP splash -7% applies only to Legendary Hand Cannons; exotic exceptions must not inherit an unconditional hand-cannon penalty.

policies: B is unsplit bodyshot damage and P is unsplit precision ratio. Direct body B(1-s), direct precision B(P-s); blast B*s*k. Apply weapon-travel falloff only to direct and independent radial falloff only to splash neighbors.

Primary survivor receives full splash once; exclude it from the neighborhood. Lethal direct still explodes at captured impact, skips a second damage to the dead primary. Entity and block contacts explode, expiry/unload do not.

Fire captures fraction, radius, mode scale and both source damage snapshots. Target geometry and live target state are evaluated at impact. Weapon source removal cannot erase accepted projectile components.
One explicit damage_group covers direct and splash commands at the contact; this does not invent a batch or universal proc deduplication.
Synthetic consumer uses kinetic damage, base10, precision2, automatic-rifle/hand-cannon range fixtures and linear radial shape. These are test inputs, not valid Destiny roll/archetype claims.
Travel falloff exemption, full primary splash, damage ordering, team/LOS policies and snapshot timing are explicit reconstruction policies pending dedicated original-game measurements.
The consumer selects scale by explicit activity mode; mixed target classes inside one mode still require live Guardian/combatant classification.
The reference projectile stops at its first contact. Damage grouping is explicit per contact; multi-contact/piercing payload grouping is not calibrated.
conflicts: Timed Payload share .55 in Compendium and Clarity versus .5 in pinned Foundry; prefer original table .55 when implementing TP.

Compendium PvP summary says body damage unchanged, but its explicit HC splash -7% and official patch imply .965 body total for Legendary HC. Preserve explicit formula; do not silently compensate direct damage.
Foundry and Clarity say Hand Cannons without the official Legendary qualifier. Preserve the narrower official scope.
